message: I always find it amusing how a good storm can turn an ordinary day into an excuse for cozy blankets and hot cocoa. 🌧️ If you're like me and enjoy that little thrill of a rainy day, it’s also a good time to think about how to stay safe at home. I came across this handy resource on preparing for floods—definitely worth a peek if you want to ensure your cozy day doesn’t turn into a soggy one! What’s your go-to comfort during stormy weather?
